clue.text: Labyrinth concealing nothing to trick no-good revolutionary leader

explanation.definitionFit: Rule by the mob is what agitators are charged with stirring up among the masses.

clue.text: Drunkards's lost direction for smokers' necessities

clue.text: Corrupt placeman without a shred of credibility select jurors
